chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Jameel ibn Salih, from the one who informed him, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
He was asked about the stars (astrology). He said: 'No one knows them except a household from the Arabs and a household from India.'

key_terms.النُّجُومِ: The stars (referring to astrology/astronomy in this context)

ai.seo_question: Who possesses knowledge of the stars according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that true knowledge of the stars is not universal but restricted to specific lineages: a household from the Arabs and a household from India. This reflects the Shia scholarly view that astrological knowledge, while distinct from divine revelation, was preserved within certain elite families, often linked to pre-Islamic or early Islamic traditions of astronomy and divination. The distinction highlights the nuanced Shia position on 'ilm al-nujum, separating it from general celestial observation and tying it to specific hereditary or specialized knowledge.

en.hubeali: H 14956 – Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Salih, from the one who informed him, the following:
I asked about the stars (Astrology) from Abu Abdullahasws. The Imamasws replied: ‘No one knows it except for a People of a household from the Arabs, and a people of a household from India’.
en.sarwar: 509. Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Abu Al-Abbas Ubeydullah Bin Ahmad Al-Dahqan, from Ali Bin Al-Hassan Al-Tatary, from Muhammad Bin Ziyad Baya’ Al-Sabiry, from Aban, from Sabbah bin Sayabat, from Al-Mu‘alla bin Khunays who said:

I went with the letters of Abdul Salaam Bin Naeem, and Sudeyr, and a letter of someone else to Abu Abdullah (a.s.), When Al-Musawwadat makes his appearance, before the appearance of the sons of Al-Abbas, we have estimated that this Command would come to you (a.s.), so what do you (a.s.) see?’ ‘He (a.s.) threw the letters on the ground, and then said: ‘Uff! Uff! I (a.s.) am not an Imam (a.s.) for these ones, but they very well know that he (ajfj) would be killing Al-Sufyani’.
